_note: Greybox Foamer rigs (menace pass, 2026-10-31) for the sandbox (sandbox.html), one per roster role in design/CONTENT-PLAN.md section 3. Shapes and proportions are placeholders for discussion, not designs: names, looks and colours are Paul's. Sizes in voxels (0.05 m). 'at' is where a part's joint sits on its parent's box and 'pivot' where it sits on the part's own box, both -1 to 1 per axis (0 centre, 1 the +x / top / front face). 'rest' is a rest rotation in radians. Feet are put on the ground automatically.

rigs.label: F01
rigs.behaviour: Slow, walks at you in groups. Bonks up close. Free finishers.

rigs.label: F02
rigs.behaviour: Agile, keeps its distance, throws slow parryable foam balls.

rigs.label: F03
rigs.behaviour: Small and fast, comes in a pack of 4 to 6.

rigs.label: F04
rigs.behaviour: Holds a shield wall and fires over it. Flank it or shield-charge it.

rigs.label: F05
rigs.behaviour: Charges in a straight line. Armoured front, weak back.

rigs.label: F06
rigs.behaviour: Floats slowly and spits bouncing blobs. Stagger it with a big hit.

rigs.label: F07
rigs.behaviour: Melee brawler. Leaps and slams down with a shockwave.

rigs.label: F08
rigs.behaviour: Slow tank. Fires walls of foam balls with gaps to slip through. Two arm launchers.

rigs.label: F09
rigs.behaviour: Turret walker on four legs. Sustained fire from a gun you can shoot off.

rigs.label: F10
rigs.behaviour: Flies on jets and fires homing foam. Shoot the jets and it falls.

rigs.label: F11
rigs.behaviour: Elite: a hulking armoured knight. Tower shield only a parry breaks; three-hit mace combo ending in a parryable finisher.

rigs.label: F12
rigs.behaviour: Hides low, creeps, then pounces from cover.

rigs.label: F13
rigs.behaviour: Support: sends foam to rebuild other Foamers. Shoot its tank first.
